light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

clips.text: Mientras lavo esto, te cuento algo. Me escribió Marta, de Arequipa, en Perú. Hizo su patio mirando un video: solo cemento y agua.
clips.action: He keeps rinsing the float under the running tap, turning his head to the friend who films as he tells the story.

clips.text: Al mes, sonaba hueco y se levantaba en placas. La segunda vez lo hizo con la carpeta, la lechada fresca y el curado.
clips.action: He puts the float down, knocks on the edge of the concrete sink with his knuckles as if something sounded hollow, then mimes a plate lifting with his flat hand.

clips.text: Me dijo que ya le pasó una temporada de lluvias encima, y sigue firme. No es magia. Es hacer los pasos en orden.
clips.action: He shrugs with a warm smile and counts one, two, three on his fingers.

clips.text: Las herramientas se lavan enseguida, eh. El cemento seco en una regla o en la escoba ya no sale.
clips.action: He picks up the aluminium straightedge from the sink and rinses the grey cement off it under the tap, rubbing with his gloved hand.

clips.text: Y si en tu casa lo que tienes es humedad que sube por el piso, eso lo explico en la guía contra la humedad de la colección.
clips.action: He turns off the tap, dries his hands on the leather apron and points toward the base of the whitewashed wall.

clips.text: Porque ahí el problema no es el piso: es el agua. El enlace está abajo. Bueno, vamos a tapar esto antes de que le dé el sol.
clips.action: He points down toward the bottom of the frame, then grabs the folded plastic sheet from beside the sink and walks toward the fresh floor.
